# The files the public repository (Pfadfinder-Adam/RTW-M2TW-Campaign-Editor) shows: the page people land on, its
# pictures and the texts it links to - no code. public.yml copies them there on every push to main that changes
# them; a path ending in / is a whole folder. The wiki (docs/wiki) goes to the public repository's wiki the same way.
